summary.text: DALGÅRD EIENDOM AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1984-07-04. DALGÅRD EIENDOM AS develops, owns and operates real estate. It was previously named NORGESGRUPPEN DAGLIGVARE MIDT-NORGE AS until 2013-10-10. Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 3 958 966 NOK and the annual result was 811 550 NOK; operating income was up from 3 904 756 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 472 476 NOK in 2024 to 811 550 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 26 435 165 NOK in 2024 to 27 246 715 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-07 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
